title: Record a judge's fenced verdicts straight from its answer
action: Red first. Per D3: in verbs/cells/judge.rs add a pure extract_fenced_verdicts(text) -> Result<Vec<(String, Value)>, String> that finds every fenced block whose opening line is three backticks then `json <cell-id>` (exactly one id token), takes the body to the closing fence, and parses it with the same JSON parser run_judge_record uses; a duplicate id is an error naming it; zero blocks is an error ('no json <cell-id> verdict block found'). In handlers_meta.rs factor the body of run_judge_record after parsing into record_one(...) and add --from-text <path|-> (stdin for -), mutually exclusive with --file; with --from-text, --id becomes optional and, when given, every block id must equal it. Record each valid block on its cell through record_one (claim guards and archive checks per cell, as today); output a JSON array of {id, recorded, errors} (text: one line per id); exit non-zero when any block failed validation or recording. Declare --from-text for cells.judge-record in catalog.rs and generated/registry_payload.json like the existing flags and keep those tests green. In skills/bee-hive/references/gates-and-delegation.md, in the Judge tier paragraph that says the judge returns the judge-verdict/1 schema recorded via cells judge-record, add one sentence: the judge returns one fenced block per cell whose info string is `json <cell-id>`, and the leader records them all with `bee cells judge-record --from-text`. Zero blocks refuse before recording anything. Tests (inline in judge.rs and handlers_meta.rs or the existing judge tests): two valid blocks record two verdicts; an invalid block is reported and the exit is non-zero while the valid one records; duplicate ids refuse; --id mismatch refuses; --file with --from-text refuses; an answer with no blocks refuses. Cite decision e7509db5 (contract:judge-record-from-text). No code comments. REVISION ROUND (judge NEEDS_REVISION; the first round is committed as a1341ec54 — make one more commit on top with the cell trailer last). Fix: (1) handlers_meta.rs test file_with_from_text_refuses compares the Debug of an Option<ExitCode> with the Debug of an ExitCode, so it can never fail; assert on the real refusal text and exit code. (2) that test resolves the real process cwd and writes a timings row into the real main store; run it against a temp repo the way the other judge-record tests do (or through the shared TEST_CWD_LOCK pattern hlt-2 uses), never the real checkout. Also two one-line fixes the judge noted in herding/run.rs: the uncapped-success line must name a runnable command including the mistakes answer, e.g. `bee cells finish --id <cell> --from-job <job> --proof-result <green:unit> --no-mistakes`; and the isolated_config check `spec.provider == "pi"` must compare case-insensitively like paseo.rs does. Run only this cell's verify commands, in the foreground; do not start the whole crate suite in the background and wait on it — commit as soon as the verify is green.
